about: KADA-18 campus facts. Researched 2 Nov 2026 (official sites, NIRF 2026, OpenStreetMap, OSRM) and from the KJU United chat analysis (KADA-13, 7 Nov). Coordinates are present only where a source gave them; otherwise mark origin approx. Excluded: PES Hanumanth Nagar (PU and diploma only) and Jain Jayanagar 3rd Block CPGS (likely closed).
